verdict.rationale: Bento documents attaching user_id, session_id, and custom tags (experiment IDs, feature flags) to every span, and it reports cost per run out of the box. The docs never show cost or usage being aggregated or broken down by those user, session, or feature dimensions, so the attribution step is only implied. missing for 10: documented cost/usage rollups grouped by user, session, or feature metadata; token-level usage attribution; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: `init()` accepts `user_id`, `session_id`, and `tags` kwargs. Bento invokes them on every span
Tag spans with experiment IDs, feature flags, anything.
you see cost per run, tool failure rates, drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.
